scenarios.name: heating on when cold
heating off when warm

cases.utterance: Add a 2-point controller for floor heating in Wohnzimmer: turn on when temperature drops below 19°C, turn off above 21°C
Use an UpDownCounter to count door openings in Eingang, reset at midnight via a DayTimer pulse

scenarios.name: output increases when dark

cases.utterance: BrightnessControl: maintain 300 lux in the living room using the Helligkeit sensor to adjust light output

scenarios.name: correct code triggers output

cases.utterance: 4-digit access code: unlock Jalousie 1 in Wohnzimmer when correct code is entered via digital inputs

scenarios.name: step up from zero

cases.utterance: AnalogStepper: adjust fan speed with up/down buttons in 25% steps, range 0–100

scenarios.name: Q1 on when cold
Q2 on when hot

cases.utterance: Use a 3-point controller for the mixing valve in Heizraum: heat when below 40°C, cool when above 50°C

scenarios.name: alarm when pressure too low

cases.utterance: AnalogWatchdog: trigger alarm when water pressure drops below 1.5 bar or exceeds 4.0 bar in Technikraum

scenarios.name: pump on when collector hotter

cases.utterance: AnalogComparator: enable solar pump when collector temperature exceeds tank temperature by 5°C

scenarios.name: toggle on

cases.utterance: EdgeWipingRelay: toggle stairway light with a push button, auto-off after 5 minutes

scenarios.name: clock drives shift

cases.utterance: Shift register to create a 4-step LED chase sequence triggered by a clock pulse in Wohnzimmer

scenarios.name: tracks max value

cases.utterance: TimeMinmax: track daily min/max outdoor temperature with reset at midnight in Wohnzimmer

scenarios.name: outputs color temperature

cases.utterance: DaylightController: adjust LED color temperature from warm 2700K at night to cool 5000K at midday

scenarios.name: triggers on large diff

cases.utterance: AnalogDiffTrigger: enable frost protection when floor surface temperature is more than 3°C below air temperature

scenarios.name: dimmer outputs value on trigger

cases.utterance: PushDimmer: press-and-hold dimmer for bedroom ceiling light, 10% steps between 5% and 100%

scenarios.name: both off gives 0
first on gives 1

cases.utterance: BinEncoder: convert two HVAC mode switches into a single analog mode value for the climate controller

scenarios.name: fan activates when humidity exceeds threshold
fan stays on after humidity drops (off-delay)
fan off when humidity never exceeded threshold

cases.utterance: A GreaterEqual block 'Feuchte hoch' already exists with threshold set to 70. Wire the Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad sensor output to its Input1. Then add an OffDelay timer (5 minutes) on the output and connect it to the Lichtsteuerung [Bad] I1 input to keep the fan running after humidity drops.

scenarios.name: garden light on when dark
garden light off when bright

cases.utterance: A Not block 'Nacht' already exists. Wire the Helligkeit sensor output to its input (so Nacht=1 when dark). Then connect the Not output to the Gartenbeleuchtung I1 input so the garden light turns on at night.

scenarios.name: blinds close when windy AND sunny
blinds do NOT close when only windy

cases.utterance: An And block 'Wind und Sonne' exists with I1 already wired to Windgeschwindigkeit. Wire I2 to Sonnenschein. Then connect the And output to Jalousie 1 [Wohnzimmer] InputTriggerDown so the blinds close when it's both windy and sunny.

scenarios.name: blinds retract on rain
blinds retract on high wind
blinds stay when no bad weather

cases.utterance: An Or block 'Wetter schlecht' exists with I1 wired to Regen. Wire I2 to a new GreaterEqual block that triggers when Windgeschwindigkeit exceeds 60 km/h. Connect the Or output to Jalousie 1 [Küche] InputTriggerUp for weather protection.

scenarios.name: light on when presence detected
light off when no presence for long time

cases.utterance: A Monoflop 'Flur Timeout' exists with Time=120. The Bewegungsmelder [Flur] is already wired to its InputTrigger. Wire the Monoflop Q output to Lichtsteuerung [Flur] I1 so the hallway light turns on for 2 minutes on motion.

scenarios.name: blinds disabled when window open
blinds enabled when window closed

cases.utterance: The Schlafzimmer has Jalousie 1 and Fensterkontakt. Add window protection logic: when the window is open (Fensterkontakt Schlafzimmer = 1), disable the blinds. Use the Fensterkontakt output wired to Jalousie 1 [Schlafzimmer] InputDisable.

scenarios.name: fan on when humidity high
fan off when humidity low (after delay)

cases.utterance: The Bad has Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad and a Lichtsteuerung. Add full humidity control: a GreaterEqual threshold at 65%, then a 10-minute OffDelay, connected to Lichtsteuerung [Bad] I2. The sensor AQ goes to the threshold Input1.

scenarios.name: frost warning activates when cold
frost warning off when warm

cases.utterance: The Garage has no frost protection. Add a GreaterEqual block (inverted: triggers when Außentemperatur drops below 3°C) and connect its output to an Or block. Wire the Or to Lichtsteuerung [Garage] I1 as a frost warning indicator.

scenarios.name: ventilation triggers on high humidity
ventilation off on low humidity

cases.utterance: The Küche has Raumfeuchtigkeit Küche but no ventilation logic. Add a threshold (GreaterEqual at 60%) and a Monoflop (15 minutes) to Lichtsteuerung [Küche] I1. Sensor AQ → threshold Input1 → Monoflop trigger → light I1.

scenarios.name: blinds close when hot and sunny
blinds stay open when sunny but cool
blinds stay open when hot but cloudy

cases.utterance: The Wohnzimmer has Jalousie 1 but no sun automation. Add a GreaterEqual block for Außentemperatur > 25°C and an And block combining it with Sonnenschein. Wire: Außentemperatur → GreaterEqual Input1, Sonnenschein → And I1, GreaterEqual Q → And I2, And Q → Jalousie 1 [Wohnzimmer] InputTriggerDown.

scenarios.name: thermostat receives room temperature

cases.utterance: The Wohnzimmer Raumregler (HeatIRoomController2) exists but has no temperature input. Wire the Raumtemperatur Wohnzimmer sensor AQ output to the Raumregler Temp input.

scenarios.name: light responds to presence
light off when no presence

cases.utterance: The Flur Lichtsteuerung exists but has no presence input. Wire the Bewegungsmelder [Flur] OutputPresence to the Lichtsteuerung [Flur] Move input for automatic motion lighting.

scenarios.name: heating pauses when window open
heating active when window closed

cases.utterance: The Wohnzimmer Raumregler has no window contact. Wire the Fensterkontakt Wohnzimmer AQ output to the Raumregler Window input so heating pauses when the window is open.

scenarios.name: garden light on with presence
garden light off after timeout

cases.utterance: The Gartenbeleuchtung exists and so does the Bewegungsmelder Garten. Add a StairwayLS between them: wire Bewegungsmelder Garten OutputPresence → StairwayLS InputTrigger, then StairwayLS Q → Gartenbeleuchtung I1. Set TimeHigh to 300 seconds.

scenarios.name: blinds close when sunny and hot
blinds stay when sunny but cool

cases.utterance: A GreaterEqual 'Sonne Trigger' exists and is wired to Jalousie 1 [Wohnzimmer] InputTriggerDown via Sonnenschein. Add a temperature guard: create a GreaterEqual for Außentemperatur > 25°C, then an And block. Rewire so Sonnenschein → And I1, new GreaterEqual Q → And I2, And Q → Jalousie InputTriggerDown. The blinds should only close when it's sunny AND hot.

scenarios.name: light on with presence trigger
light stays on after presence ends (timeout period)
light off after full timeout

cases.utterance: The Gartenbeleuchtung currently receives a direct signal from Bewegungsmelder Garten OutputPresence to its I1 input — but it has no timeout, staying on only while presence is active. Add a StairwayLS (10 minutes) between them: rewire so presence → StairwayLS InputTrigger → Gartenbeleuchtung I1.

scenarios.name: AC activates when warm outside and triggered
AC blocked when cold outside

cases.utterance: The Klimaanlage [Wohnzimmer] has inTempCurr wired to Raumtemperatur Wohnzimmer but no outdoor temperature guard. Add a GreaterEqual (Außentemperatur > 20°C) and wire its output to an And block. Wire And I1 from the existing AC on signal and And I2 from GreaterEqual Q. Connect And Q to Klimaanlage.on input so AC only starts when it's warm outside.

scenarios.name: blinds retract on high wind
blinds stay when wind is calm

cases.utterance: Jalousie 2 [Flur] has InputTriggerDown wired to Sonnenschein for automatic shading. Add wind safety: create a GreaterEqual for Windgeschwindigkeit > 50, wire it to Jalousie 2 [Flur] InputTriggerUp so high wind retracts the blinds regardless of sun.

scenarios.name: should open garage when car detected in dark
should NOT open garage when bright outside
should auto-close after timer expires (falling edge)

cases.utterance: When the Garagentor Sensor detects the car arriving and the Helligkeit sensor reads below 50 lux (it's dark), open the Garagentor. After 5 minutes with no further trigger, auto-close it via a Monoflop timer.

scenarios.name: should turn on garage light when door opens
should NOT be on when door has not opened

cases.utterance: When the Garagentor Sensor triggers (door opens), keep the Garagenlicht on for exactly 3 minutes using a StairwayLS block, then turn off automatically.

scenarios.name: should block garage door during storm (high wind + rain)
should allow garage door when wind is low
should allow garage door when not raining despite wind

cases.utterance: Block the Garagentor from operating during a storm: when Windgeschwindigkeit exceeds 60 km/h AND Regen is active, disable the Garagentor by wiring through a Not gate to cut the control signal.

scenarios.name: should disable irrigation when raining
should disable irrigation when soil moisture high
should allow irrigation when dry and no rain

cases.utterance: Disable the Bewässerungsventil whenever the Regen sensor is active OR the Feuchtesensor Garten reads above 60%. Use an Or gate combining rain and a GreaterEqual on soil moisture to inhibit the valve.

scenarios.name: should water when schedule active and conditions met
should NOT water when raining despite schedule
should NOT water when too cold despite schedule

cases.utterance: Set up timed watering: a DayTimer schedules the Bewässerungsventil daily from 06:00 to 06:30, but only if there is no rain (Not on Regen) AND the Außentemperatur is above 5°C (GreaterEqual). All three conditions must be met via an And gate.

scenarios.name: should switch to mains when cistern low
should stay on cistern when level adequate

cases.utterance: When the Pegelsensor (cistern level) drops below 20%, switch from cistern to mains water: wire the Pegelsensor through a Less block (threshold 20) and use its output to activate the Bewässerungsventil as mains water fallback.

scenarios.name: should run pump when scheduled and warm enough
should NOT run pump when freezing despite schedule
should NOT run pump outside schedule even if warm

cases.utterance: Run the Poolpumpe between 10:00 and 16:00 using a DayTimer, but disable it completely if the Außentemperatur drops below 2°C (frost). Use a Less block for the frost check and an And gate to combine schedule with frost protection.

scenarios.name: should heat when below target temp
should stop heating when target reached

cases.utterance: Control a sauna heater (use Lüfter Bad as heater output): a GreaterEqual block compares Pool Temperatur (repurposed as sauna sensor) against a target of 80°C. A HourCounter tracks total heater runtime and triggers a safety cutoff after 3 hours (Maintenance=3). Wire so the heater runs only when below target AND within the safety time limit.

scenarios.name: should close pool cover at sunset (no sunshine)
should NOT close pool cover while sunny

cases.utterance: Close the pool cover (use Jalousie 1 [Garten] as pool cover) automatically when the Sonnenschein sensor drops to 0 (sunset indicator). Wire Sonnenschein through a Less block (threshold 1) to detect sunset, then trigger InputTriggerDown on the Jalousie.

scenarios.name: should activate driveway heat on frost risk (cold + humid)
should NOT activate when warm enough
should NOT activate when humidity low despite cold

cases.utterance: Activate driveway heating (use Heizkörper Bad as heating output) when frost risk is detected: Außentemperatur below 1°C AND Luftfeuchtigkeit above 85%. Combine a Less block on temperature with a GreaterEqual on humidity through an And gate.

scenarios.name: should close valve when freezing
should keep valve open when warm
hysteresis: should remain closed at 1°C (between On and Off)

cases.utterance: Frost protection for outdoor water: when the Außentemperatur drops below 0°C, close the Bewässerungsventil. Use an AnalogThresholdTrigger with On=0 and Off=2 to add hysteresis — the valve reopens only when temperature rises above 2°C.

scenarios.name: should latch on mailbox open
should stay latched after mailbox closes

cases.utterance: Mailbox notification: when the Türkontakt Eingang (repurposed as mailbox sensor) triggers, latch a FlipFlop to remember mail has arrived. At 08:00 each morning, fire a PulseAt notification. The FlipFlop resets daily via a second PulseAt at 23:00.

scenarios.name: should turn on light on motion at night
should NOT turn on light on motion during day
should NOT turn on light at night without motion

cases.utterance: Outdoor camera light: when the Bewegungsmelder Garten detects motion AND the Helligkeit sensor reads below 30 lux (nighttime), turn on the Gartenbeleuchtung for 2 minutes using a StairwayLS. The And gate combines motion with darkness.

scenarios.name: should open gate on intercom ring
should open gate on card reader
should NOT open gate without any trigger

cases.utterance: Electric gate control: open the Türöffner when either the Türklingel rings (intercom) OR the Schalter 1 activates (card reader), using an Or gate. After opening, auto-close after 30 seconds via a Monoflop with falling-edge detection.

scenarios.name: should open coop door at sunrise (bright)
should close coop door at sunset (dark)
should neither open nor close during twilight

cases.utterance: Chicken coop door automation: open the Jalousie 2 [Garten] (coop door) at sunrise when Helligkeit rises above 100 lux, and close it at sunset when Helligkeit drops below 20 lux. Use a GreaterEqual for sunrise trigger and a Less for sunset trigger.
